la:adj:vegetus.gloss: enlivened, lively, animated, vigorous, active, brisk, sprightly
senses: enlivened, lively, animated, vigorous, active, brisk, sprightly
la:adj:vegetus.html:
vĕgĕtus, a, um, adj.
vegeo
,
enlivened, lively, animated, vigorous, active, brisk, sprightly (class.; cf.: acer, alacer, valens).
Lit.: te vegetum nobis in Graeciā siste,: fessi cum recentibus ac vegetis pugnabant,: vegetus praescripta ad munia surgit,: nigris vegetisque oculis, valetudine prosperā,: vegetior ab inferis recurrit,.—Comp.: vegetior aspectus (tauri),.—Sup.: vegetissimus color conchyliorum,.—
Trop.: mens,: sed vegetum ingenium in vivido pectore vigebat,: tertia pars rationis et mentis,: libertas,: gustus,keen,.—Sup.: hoc intervallum temporis vegetissimum agricolis maximeque operosum est,the liveliest, busiest,.

senses: able to produce and support growth, vegetative
